items.headline: $TIA Jumps 23% in a Day, Extending Four-Week Rally
items.summary: Celestia's $TIA surged 23% in 24 hours, stretching its month-long rally. Daily fees ticked up to $158 even as data posted to the network slipped slightly.

items.headline: $MORPHO Launches Onchain Credit Network for DeFi
items.summary: $MORPHO unveiled a new onchain credit network aimed at transforming DeFi lending, expanding its push beyond isolated markets into broader credit infrastructure.

items.headline: $CRV Debuts New Borrowing Feature for LPs
items.summary: Curve launched an innovative borrowing feature built for liquidity providers, giving $CRV users a fresh DeFi use case and new ways to leverage LP positions.

items.headline: $CAKE: PancakeSwap Reveals Dual Investments, Fee Cuts
items.summary: PancakeSwap announced dual investments alongside fee structure adjustments, a major ecosystem shake-up for $CAKE holders as the DEX retools its tokenomics.

items.headline: $PENDLE Rolls Out Live Risk Input for Aave Markets
items.summary: $PENDLE introduced live input tooling for Aave's risk management, deepening its integration with blue-chip DeFi and expanding its yield-trading footprint.
